name: Stage1a small pixel-video generation probe, NOT full ATB/latent Stage1

selection.rule: SHA256 order of previously unused official train source IDs; first12 valid foreground videos and first12 backgrounds;8 train/2 dev/2 test
selection.source_family_note: video IDs isolated; no identity/actor/background-near-duplicate oracle

data.renderer: unchanged public MPIB layered aperture-ray kernel in linear light
data.target_dtype: float16 linear-render then sRGB, independently stored; RGB input PNG8 reloaded by all methods
data.label: synthetic layered-renderer reference, not measured real bokeh GT
data.focus_depth: median known visible binary depth in same user-box; GT focus only renderer/oracle, not deployable arms
data.normalization: sRGB RGB/target in[0,1], no scene-dependent normalization
data.source_start_policy: Default0; if first25 contain empty foreground, earliest consecutive25 with alpha>128 present, fixed before rendering/model outputs; gen09 start26; IDs/splits unchanged

geometry.feature_cache: BF16 backbone spatial tokens stored float16; exact same call yields depth
geometry.preprocess: official crop 448x252 ->518x294; no crop; depth bilinear inverse resize, tokens spatially resampled
geometry.token_condition: parameter-free channel L2, learned2048->32 projection; focus area pooling and [f,q,f-q,f*q] ->32
geometry.depth_condition: dense centered log-depth and log(median predicted depth in focus)/depth, clipped[-4,4]/4; learned2->32 adapter
geometry.oracle: same depth condition but known visible binary plane depths; no alpha/RGB hidden target input

generator.type: shared from-scratch small RGB residual encoder-decoder with 3D temporal bottleneck
generator.output: clip(RGB+(K/32)*delta,0,1), zero-K identity by construction; common output head zero-init
generator.reason: bounded generation-task probe before committing to expensive latent diffusion integration
generator.matching: identical shared trunk initialization and training batches; different condition adapter dimensions/counts disclosed, not perfectly matched total parameter count

train.loss: mean RGB L1 only; no temporal/perceptual loss
train.checkpoint: fixed final2000, no dev model selection
train.schedule: same precomputed scene/group/focus/K batch order for every arm; no augmentation

evaluation.primary: per-source mean frame PSNR at K16/32 then source-equal mean
evaluation.region: shared GT alpha only for evaluation; boundary dilate5(alpha>.01)-erode5(alpha>.99);exclude12px border
evaluation.temporal: no flicker score without motion compensation; five-frame nonoverlapping group boundaries are reported
evaluation.heldout: two preselected new sources, evaluated once after fixed training; no tuning based on dev or test

limits: 12 planar composite sources only; single seed, artificial camera/depth distribution
Known hidden background makes renderer defined, not native Sintel blur fabrication
Does not establish physical real-video fidelity, generalization, ATB gains or superiority of full latent systems
No benchmark training, no DAVIS isolated-group access; visual quality judgments remain user
